first_attempt.evidence: uv reported: Failed to download distribution due to network timeout.

protocol_deviation.reason: The runtime classifier did not recognize uv's explicit network-timeout wording, so it exposed a censored C0 as a semantic failure and incorrectly launched C1/T.
protocol_deviation.primary_analysis_disposition: Exclude both continuations and do not count this position as a valid feedback opportunity.

C1.interpretation: The materially unchanged installation succeeded on retry, confirming the C0 failure was transient infrastructure.

T.interpretation: The treatment overreacted to a transient download failure by pruning the all extras and introduced new missing-import constraints.

primary_contrast.reason: The unchanged C0 Official-passed on its required infrastructure retry, so no failure-conditioned causal branch comparison was eligible under the preregistration.

measurement_observation: The unchanged C0 retry passed, confirming that exact target feedback can be harmful when infrastructure noise is mislabeled as a deployment constraint. Reliable observation typing is therefore a precondition for the repair operation, not an optional reporting detail.
